content.content:
Licence check, applied by a reviewer reading the recorded nodes; nothing runs.

(1) License against the prerequisite. Read the dependent's recorded clause against zzzzzzzz and fail, naming the contradicting element and the way it contradicts, on any element of the clause that contradicts it. The root carries no node file and states no rule, so this half binds nothing on its own; it is recorded so that the edge's use is stated rather than assumed.

(2) Single recorded identity. Read the extension identity off the subject: the identifier its clause names and the display form the node records for that identifier, taken from the clause, the rationale and any material the ref points at. Fail, naming the elements at issue, on any of: (a) the identifier recorded in more than one form; (b) an identifier recorded with no display form for it anywhere in the node; (c) a display form whose words are not the words of the recorded identifier — separators, case and spacing may differ, so one identity spelled in two registers is not a finding, while two different names are; (d) one part of the node retaining a form that another part has replaced.

(3) The check names no identifier, no display form and no wording of the clause in advance, and requires no sentence, order or vocabulary; which element is at issue, if any, is named only in the check's output. Pinning the extension's identifier or display form here would be a wording echo of the dependent and would fail on a lawful rewording, so it is not this clause's job.

(4) A placeholder, empty or clause-less recorded content leaves the check with no subject to read: fail, naming the placeholder.
content.rationale: Derivation, not a choice of convenience: uuutyrzs is ref "inline" with type "text", a commitment in words, so it is the natural layer, and its only recorded prerequisite zzzzzzzz is the graph root, which has no node file and no content, so it has no layer at all. eval-matrix.md has no row for a content-less parent used by a natural child; that pair takes the matrix's documented default, the gate form of evals/natural-to-natural.md, flagged here as a gap the matrix should record. Nothing runs, which is what the natural child's strictness rule requires: a child in words is checked for non-violation and never for behaviour, and the ref is inline criteria because this node adds no repo path. depends_on is [zzzzzzzz] because that is the prerequisite of the only edge this evaluation can cover: uuutyrzs depends on the repo root, so the root is the set the use is checked against, and it is the target's own recorded prerequisite rather than an invented one. The target itself is not a lawful prerequisite: an edge has a dependent and a prerequisite, and an evaluation depending on the node it evaluates states no edge at all, so this node does not depend on uuutyrzs even though its skeleton was positioned below that target by `deccy new --on uuutyrzs`. The use the edge records is thin by construction. uuutyrzs is the graph's seed clause for the extension's identity, and what it takes from the root is standing only: the root states no rule, so the licence half has nothing to contravene, and the check's teeth are the identity clauses, which constrain the subject itself — something a gate may do — rather than inventing a rule for the root to have stated. Clauses (2b) to (2d) are the absence-is-a-finding shape the graph's other words-layer gates already use: the check reads two elements off the subject, the identifier and the display form recorded for it, and an identity stated in one register only, or in two registers that name different things, is what the check is for. Clause (2c) is stated as a tolerance on the relation between the two registers, not as either value: the words must match, the separators, case and spacing need not. What the check deliberately does not do is pin the identifier or the display form as strings. Naming them here would be the wording echo of the dependent that the natural-to-natural cell forbids and would fail the independence test by reading the dependent back to itself; the identity the rename actually changes is pinned where the repository's artifacts carry it, by the conformance and test gates over the code-layer dependents that own the manifest, the shell and the README.
